profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Volant Partners
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer at Volant Partners
profile.summary:
Software Architect, Project Lead and Senior Software Engineer for real time and server side system applications. Expertise in Object Oriented design and development of mission critical solutions, from high performance distributed servers to real time embedded systems for the banking, aerospace and Defense industries. Highly motivated, autonomous, with a strong emphasis on methodology, software quality, teamwork, customer care and process. Native French. US Citizen.

Specialties: Linux (RedHat, Fedora, Ubuntu, CentOS), Embedded Linux (uClinux on ARM, EmbeddedPlanet on PowerPC), AIX, Green Hills Integrity, VRTX, Windows Server

Cordova/PhoneGap On Android. Javascript, JQuery, JQuery Mobile, JSF (ICEfaces), Web Services (AXIS, .NET WCF), SOAP, Apache Tomcat,
Swing, JNI, JTRS, SCA, CORBA, .NET, WIN32, MFC, COM, UML.
C, C++, C#, Java, Java-Script, JSP, PHP,
Assemblers (POWER, X86, PA, SPARC, ARM, MIPS, …),
Microcontrollers (PowerPC, ARM ATMEL, 8051).
JDeveloper (Java), Visual Studio(C/C++/C#), Eclipse(C/C++/Java/PrismTech SPECTRA/Android).
ClearCase, Visual Source Safe, SVN.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, development and implementation of In-Flight Entertainment content load. Support of Client’s development effort for different subsystems and programs.
Development under Eclipse in C++, Python on Linux (x86/ARM). QT/QML.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, development, integration and production support for distributed asynchronous large-scale real time mobile data collection, warehousing and reporting system for the transportation industry.

Development in C#, JavaSCRIPT, Sencha Ext JS, Flash and .NET with integration services handled with C#, SOAP and XML.
Data repository is managed in MS SQL Server with multidimensional Cube performance optimization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
JTRS Devices – Staff Software Engineer

Support of the development of Joint Tactical Radio System (JTRS) for Software Defined Radios. C++, GreenHills, CORBA, SCA. Radio Devices Interfaces.

Drone Ground Control Station Support – Staff Software Engineer	

Design, development and integration of geospatial mapping software for a drone ground flight control system.
Researched, proposed and selected Open Source solutions to prototype and implement missing critical functionality to display aircraft position in real time on maps..
Design and Implementation of a gateway for drone flight telemetry to legacy defense networks.
Development in C++ on Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Service Oriented Architecture application for aircraft maintenance applications. Tomcat Web Application Server, AXIS Web Service, JSF(ICEfaces).

positions.title: Embedded Systems – Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a Board Support Package (BSP) for an embedded real time Linux (uClinux) on an ATMEL ARM 7 Core. Ported the Kernel Linux 2.6 and associated Open Source packages to the new BSP.
Developed Kernel drivers (USB, SPI, CAN Bus, GPIO) and ported Open Source Drivers (RTC, Serial, Flash) to the BSP.
Created Board Simulation software based on the GNU Debugger (ARMulator) to emulate in software all hardware components (USB, CAN, Serial, SPI, RTC) to be able to port the Linux Kernel in parallel to the Hardware development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Manager of a team of five to six Software Engineers.
Specified and architected a new XML core database engine based on the Company’s legacy database core components.
Designed and implemented a database access method, optimized for partial updates and retrievals of large documents resulting in increased performance aimed at document retrieval systems and large document centric databases.
Engineered a distributed Query Engine to support a high performance Java based XPath/XQuery engine and a C++ SQL engine on multiple platforms (Windows 2000/XP/Server and multi-threaded POSIX systems (Solaris 9, 10, Linux RedHat, AIX).
Refactored the Company Microsoft Transaction Server (MTS) Resource Manager to provide an XA compatible interface.

positions.title: NT Development Manager
positions.description:
Manager of a team of five to six Software Engineers.
Promoted and developed a new product line based on Windows NT that accounts for 40% of the current database revenues.
Managed all aspects of the product cycle, from the interface with Marketing, specifications, development, and documentation, up to delivery to QA, Technical Support training and assistance, and major customers pre- and post-sales support.
Architected the implementation of the Pick Systems multi-dimensional database model to create a distributed, n-tiered, multi-threaded database environment based on COM and RPC) in order to open the legacy Pick marketplace to Windows services (COM, RPC, IOs, printing, backup, and authentication.
Implemented OLE Structured Storage, OLE DB resource provider, MTS Resource Manager for Pick Systems’ Database, ODBC connectivity, MQ Series-based data replication.
Hired and mentored junior engineers and performed employee reviews.

positions.title: Kernel Development Manager
positions.description:
Manager of a team of five Software Engineers.
Introduced the UNIX-based product line in the Company that eventually phased out the proprietary OS implementations and now represents 60% of the database revenues.
Created, managed  and trained the UNIX core group.
Architected and designed the implementation of Pick Systems’ Virtual Machine on UNIX platforms. Developed all system interfaces to UNIX (process management, IOs). Created a suite of conventional and optimizing RISC cross-assemblers and related tools on multiple processors (X86, POWER, PA, 88K, SPARC) and multiple Unix platforms (Linux, AIX, HP-UX, SCO, DG-UX, ICL, AT&T)

positions.title: System Software Lead
positions.description:
Managed the project, specified, designed and implemented all system software and drivers on Unix SV and Pick OS: OSI transport driver, network drivers (Token Ring LAN, X.25) and SCSI IO controllers.
Implemented the Pick Operating System and Virtual Machine on a 68K line of high reliability computers for government agencies.
Designed and implemented a high performance SCSI IO controller under a real time executive (VRTX).
Supervised contractors for quality and conformity to requirements.
Developed network layers (X.25, SDLC) on a line of Automated Teller Machines.
Supported the development of a DES encryption/decryption micro-controller (8051) for credit card production.
